title: All-Plus QED Wavefunctions in de Sitter Space
summary: We present a compact all-multiplicity formula for tree-level late-time wavefunction coefficients of scalar QED in four-dimensional de Sitter space, with a conformally coupled charged scalar pair and positive-helicity photons. The result admits both a recursive representation in terms of shifted lower-point coefficients and an explicit finite sum involving only kinematic factors. The flat-space amplitudes vanish for two or more photons, yet the de Sitter coefficients remain nonzero.
